note: Internal prioritization policy, not regulatory/legal requirements or validated financial risk. Labels require human audit.

positive.description: Customer expresses satisfaction, appreciation, or delight.

neutral.description: Informational, ambiguous, or no strong emotional valence.

negative.description: Customer expresses dissatisfaction, frustration, or complaint.

mixed.description: Review contains both positive and negative signals.
mixed.default_action: Flag for product and CX review

technical_failure.description: App or backend technically broken: crashes, force-close, OTP not delivered, API/server error, notification failure, UI regression after update. Core functionality does not work.
technical_failure.escalation_note: Assign to on-call engineer. Check Sentry / crash dashboard.

access_blocked.description: Customer cannot get into the app: login failure, biometric failure, password reset broken, device limit exceeded, KYC block, session expiry loop, developer-options restriction.
access_blocked.escalation_note: If KYC-related escalate to Compliance. Log device fingerprint.

payment_failure.description: A payment, transfer, top-up, QR, or bill payment initiated by the customer did not complete or shows in an error/stuck state. Includes LankaPay / CEFT / SLIPS rail failures and QR failures.
payment_failure.escalation_note: Internal triage guidance only. Compliance determines any reporting duties after investigation.

data_integrity_issue.description: Customer sees wrong balance, missing or duplicate transaction, incorrect statement, or data that does not match what the bank holds.
data_integrity_issue.escalation_note: Internal triage guidance only. Compliance determines any reporting duties after investigation.

service_quality.description: App technically works but is slow, laggy, unresponsive, times out, or is painful to use due to performance degradation.
service_quality.escalation_note: Check infra metrics for same time window. Correlate with deploy events.

support_failure.description: Customer explicitly says support ignored them, gave no reply, was unhelpful after multiple contacts, or the complaint channel itself is broken.
support_failure.escalation_note: Pattern of support failures is a regulatory risk. Flag to CRO if 3+ in same week.

interbank_transfer_failure.description: Transfer to another Sri Lankan bank failed or is stuck — specifically LankaPay, CEFT, SLIPS, or RTGS rail. Distinct from internal transfers within the same bank.
interbank_transfer_failure.escalation_note: Internal triage guidance only. Compliance determines any reporting duties after investigation.
interbank_transfer_failure.v1_equivalent: NEW — was previously lost inside complaint/api_failure

agent_banking_issue.description: Problem related to agent banking: field agent not available, agent gave wrong information, agent machine down, Sampath Vishwa / BOC agent network failure, or mismatch between agent record and app record.
agent_banking_issue.escalation_note: Rural customers disproportionately affected. Escalate if cluster of reports from same region.
agent_banking_issue.v1_equivalent: NEW — previously undetected, fell into noise or general complaint

fx_conversion_complaint.description: Complaint about forex rate, remittance, foreign currency conversion, or multi-currency wallet. Includes diaspora remittance to Sri Lanka and disagreement on exchange rate applied.
fx_conversion_complaint.escalation_note: Internal triage guidance only. Compliance determines any reporting duties after investigation.
fx_conversion_complaint.v1_equivalent: NEW — previously fell into refund_request or noise

ux_friction.description: Usability or flow friction — app works but is hard to use, confusing, or poorly designed.
ux_friction.escalation_note: Group by screen/flow for sprint planning.

refund_request.description: Customer asks for refund, reversal, or money back.
refund_request.escalation_note: Internal triage guidance only. Compliance determines any reporting duties after investigation.

security_concern.description: Reported credential compromise, unauthorized access or unauthorized transactions; prioritize over refund or closure requests when an incident is also reported.

regulatory_risk.description: Explicit compliance/legal concern requiring review. An ordinary login or KYC problem is not proof of a regulatory violation.
regulatory_risk.escalation_note: Must be logged before end of business day.

complaint.description: Broken feature, failed transaction, or blocked access.
complaint.escalation_note: Assign to on-call engineer if P0 root cause.

churn_signal.description: Customer threatens to leave or switch provider.

competitor_switch.description: Customer explicitly states they are moving to a named competitor.
competitor_switch.escalation_note: Log competitor name in competitive intelligence tracker.

account_closure.description: Explicit request to close/deactivate an account. Mentioning an account or password is not closure. Security incidents take priority.
account_closure.escalation_note: Internal triage guidance only. Compliance determines any reporting duties after investigation.

feature_request.description: Customer requests a new capability or improvement.
feature_request.escalation_note: Tag with feature area for roadmap clustering.

praise.description: Positive experience or endorsement — no action needed.

noise.description: Gibberish, spam, off-topic, or unreadable text.

authentication_failure.description: Login failure, password reset failure, or session expires repeatedly. Does NOT cover biometric (see biometric_failure) or OTP issues (see notification_delivery_failure / otp_loop_failure).
authentication_failure.review_example: Cannot log in even with correct password

biometric_failure.description: Fingerprint or face ID does not work in the app — either refuses to scan, loops, or reverts to PIN without explanation. Split from authentication_failure for precise routing to mobile security team.
biometric_failure.review_example: Fingerprint won't work, keeps asking for PIN

device_limit_exceeded.description: Blocked by registered-device limit or device policy.

notification_delivery_failure.description: OTP or verification SMS is never received at all — does not arrive even after retries. Distinct from otp_loop_failure where OTP arrives but is rejected.
notification_delivery_failure.review_example: I never receive the OTP SMS

otp_loop_failure.description: OTP arrives correctly but the app rejects it, calls it expired immediately, or loops the OTP screen endlessly. Different from notification_delivery_failure (OTP not received).
otp_loop_failure.review_example: OTP comes but app says invalid / expired immediately

slow_performance.description: App speed, latency, timeout, or lag problems — app still works.

app_crash_or_bug.description: App crashes, freezes, or has a persistent UI bug — NOT caused by a recent update. If the crash started after an update use app_update_regression.
app_crash_or_bug.review_example: App crashes every time I open it

app_update_regression.description: App worked before but broke after a specific version update. Signals a regression introduced by the release team. CRO flag true because mass regressions generate surge in negative reviews and may affect CBS integration.
app_update_regression.review_example: After the latest update the app won't open at all
app_update_regression.v1_equivalent: NEW — split from app_crash_or_bug for release management routing

api_failure.description: Internal API call fails, backend endpoint errors, or service unavailable — for transfers or payments within the same bank's system.
api_failure.review_example: Payment fails with 'server error' on internal transfer

lankapay_ceft_failure.description: Transfer via LankaPay, CEFT, or SLIPS rail fails or gets stuck. Distinct from api_failure (internal) — this involves the national payment infrastructure. Requires internal investigation; Compliance determines reporting duties.
lankapay_ceft_failure.review_example: Transfer to Sampath Bank never arrived — deducted from my account
lankapay_ceft_failure.v1_equivalent: NEW — previously classified as api_failure, losing CBSL escalation signal

qr_payment_failure.description: Lanka QR or in-app QR code scan payment fails — QR does not scan, payment does not process after scan, or merchant does not receive funds.
qr_payment_failure.review_example: QR code payment failed at the supermarket — was embarrassing
qr_payment_failure.v1_equivalent: NEW — previously lost in api_failure or app_crash_or_bug

data_sync_issue.description: Balances, transactions, or records do not sync or display correctly.
data_sync_issue.review_example: My balance shows wrong amount after transfer

security_restriction_ux.description: Legitimate security control causes access friction or user block.
security_restriction_ux.review_example: Have to turn off developer options just to open the app

poor_security_implementation.description: Weak, broken, or band-aid security identified by customer.
poor_security_implementation.review_example: Their fix just breaks USB debugging — not real security

regulatory_block.description: Issue caused by compliance rules, KYC, or regulatory checks — and the customer KNOWS the reason (e.g. 'my KYC failed'). If customer says account frozen with NO reason given, use account_freeze_no_reason instead.
regulatory_block.review_example: The app says my KYC verification failed

account_freeze_no_reason.description: Customer reports a frozen, blocked or restricted account with no communicated explanation. The cause and any reporting obligations require investigation.
account_freeze_no_reason.review_example: Account blocked without any reason or notice — can't access my money
account_freeze_no_reason.v1_equivalent: NEW — previously misclassified as authentication_failure or regulatory_block

unjustified_billing.description: Unexpected charge, fee dispute, or billing complaint (general).
unjustified_billing.review_example: Charged annual fee for an app that doesn't work

fee_without_service.description: Customer reports a fee for a service that failed or was not delivered. Investigate the transaction before deciding on a refund.
fee_without_service.review_example: Charged Rs.50 transaction fee but the transfer failed

misleading_promotion.description: Customer reports an advertised offer or cashback was not honored. Verify terms and events before determining whether advertising was misleading.
misleading_promotion.review_example: Promised 10% cashback but only got 2% — nowhere does it say that limit
misleading_promotion.v1_equivalent: NEW — previously fell into feature_request or general_satisfaction

agent_network_failure.description: Field agent unavailable, agent machine/terminal down, agent gave incorrect information, or mismatch between agent record and app record. Relevant to Sampath Vishwa, BOC Mobile Banking, and other agent networks.
agent_network_failure.review_example: Agent in my area is never available — nearest one is 10km away
agent_network_failure.v1_equivalent: NEW — previously fell into noise or general complaint

fx_rate_dispute.description: Customer disputes the forex rate applied, remittance conversion, or multi-currency wallet rate. Relevant for diaspora inward remittances and foreign card transactions processed in Sri Lanka.
fx_rate_dispute.review_example: Applied a terrible exchange rate on my remittance — lost Rs.5000
fx_rate_dispute.v1_equivalent: NEW — previously fell into refund_request or noise

unresponsive_support.description: Support is slow, ignored, unhelpful, or unresponsive.

competitor_reference.description: Customer explicitly names or recommends a competing app or bank.
competitor_reference.review_example: HNB app is much better — switching to them

offer_discoverability.description: Customer appreciates easy access to offers or useful features.
offer_discoverability.review_example: I can now find offers easily

financial_safety_confidence.description: Customer explicitly trusts the app for safe financial transactions.
financial_safety_confidence.review_example: Always keeps checking — feels very safe

general_satisfaction.description: Overall positive experience without a specific feature driver.
general_satisfaction.review_example: Best banking app in Sri Lanka

unreadable_text.description: Review is gibberish, emoji-only, random characters, or spam.

other.description: Does not fit any defined root cause — use sparingly.
other.review_example: Edge case not covered by taxonomy

suspected_account_compromise.description: Customer reports leaked credentials or unauthorized account access. Reported symptom, not a verified technical cause.

suspected_unauthorized_transaction.description: Customer reports a payment, withdrawal or transfer they did not authorize. Must be investigated; do not infer a software vulnerability.

risk_bands.action: Assign to Product team this week
Escalate to Head of Product within 24h

security_triage.note: Provisional internal priorities, not calibrated scores; validate with company incident data.

risk_score_method.name: expected_band_midpoint
risk_score_method.note: Ordinal band display conversion; not a regression model or probability of loss.
